+"""Add business_id, industry, date_onboarded, client_status, first_lead_id, first_inquiry_id to clients.
+
+Revision ID: 0011_client_business_id
+Revises: 0015_named_constraints
+Create Date: 2026-06-22
+
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sqlalchemy as sa
+from alembic import op
+
+from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
+from src.backend.models.client import Client
+
+
+revision = "0011_client_business_id"
+down_revision = "0015_named_constraints"
+branch_labels = None
+depends_on = None
+
+
+def upgrade() -> None:
+    # Add new columns
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("business_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("industry", sa.VARCHAR(120), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("date_onboarded", sa.DATE(), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("client_status", sa.VARCHAR(32), nullable=False, server_default="Active"))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("first_lead_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
+    op.add_column("clients", sa.Column("first_inquiry_id", sa.VARCHAR(64), nullable=True))
+
+    # Create indexes
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_business_id", "clients", ["business_id"], unique=True)
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_industry", "clients", ["industry"])
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_client_status", "clients", ["client_status"])
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_first_lead_id", "clients", ["first_lead_id"])
+    op.create_index("ix_clients_first_inquiry_id", "clients", ["first_inquiry_id"])
+
+    # Backfill existing clients with business_id
+    conn = op.get_bind()
+    # Get all existing clients
+    existing_clients = conn.execute(sa.select(Client.id, Client.created_at).where(Client.deleted_at.is_(None))).fetchall()
+    for client_id, created_at in existing_clients:
+        # Extract year from created_at or use current year
+        year = created_at.year if created_at else 2026
+        # Generate business_id for each client
+        business_id = next_business_id(conn, "CLT", year)
+        conn.execute(
+            sa.update(Client)
+            .where(Client.id == client_id)
+            .values(business_id=business_id)
+        )
+
+
+def downgrade() -> None:
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_first_inquiry_id", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_first_lead_id", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_client_status", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_industry", "clients")
+    op.drop_index("ix_clients_business_id", "clients")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "first_inquiry_id")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "first_lead_id")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "client_status")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "date_onboarded")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "industry")
+    op.drop_column("clients", "business_id")

+import uuid
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.deps import get_current_user, require_role
+from src.backend.core.roles import Role
+from src.backend.db.session import get_db
+from src.backend.models.user import User
+from src.backend.schemas.admin_process import (
+    AdminProcessCreate,
+    AdminProcessListResponse,
+    AdminProcessRead,
+    AdminProcessUpdate,
+)
+from src.backend.services.admin_process_service import process_service
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/admin-processes", tags=["admin-processes"])
+
+
+@router.get("", response_model=AdminProcessListResponse)
+def list_processes(
+    _: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN)),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
+    q: str | None = None,
+) -> AdminProcessListResponse:
+    items, total, page, page_size = process_service.list_processes_service(
+        db, page=page, page_size=page_size, q=q
+    )
+    return AdminProcessListResponse(
+        items=[AdminProcessRead.model_validate(p) for p in items],
+        total=total,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+
+@router.post("", response_model=AdminProcessRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+def create_process(
+    body: AdminProcessCreate,
+    current_user: User = Depends(require_role(Role.ADMIN)),  # noqa: B008
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),  # noqa: B008
+) -> AdminProcessRead:
+    from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
+
+    try:
+        process = process_service.create_process_service(db, body, current_user.id)
+        return AdminProcessRead.model_validate(process)

+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Query, UploadFile, status
+from fastapi.responses import FileResponse
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.deps import get_current_user
+from src.backend.db.session import get_db
+from src.backend.models.drn import DocType, DocumentNature, DRNStatus, IntendedUser
+from src.backend.models.user import User
+from src.backend.schemas.drn import (
+    DRNListResponse,
+    DRNRead,
+    DRNUpdate,
+)
+from src.backend.services import drn_service
+
+router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["drn"])
+
+
+@router.post("/drns", response_model=DRNRead, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
+def create_drn(
+    file: UploadFile | None = File(None),
+    doc_type: str = Form(...),
+    date: str = Form(...),
+    associated_project_id: str | None = Form(None),
+    associated_token_id: str | None = Form(None),
+    author_id: str | None = Form(None),
+    document_nature: str = Form(DocumentNature.INTERNAL.value),
+    intended_user: str = Form(IntendedUser.INTERNAL.value),
+    description: str = Form(...),
+    revision: str = Form("R0"),
+    status: str = Form(DRNStatus.DRAFT.value),
+    remarks: str | None = Form(None),
+    current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    if file and file.filename:
+        if len(file.file.read()) > drn_service.MAX_FILE_SIZE:
+            raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_413_REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE, detail="File exceeds 50MB limit")
+        file.file.seek(0)
+
+    try:
+        doc_type_enum = DocType(doc_type)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid doc_type. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DocType)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    try:
+        document_nature_enum = DocumentNature(document_nature)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid document_nature. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DocumentNature)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    try:
+        intended_user_enum = IntendedUser(intended_user)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid intended_user. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in IntendedUser)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    try:
+        status_enum = DRNStatus(status)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid status. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DRNStatus)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    file_bytes = None
+    original_filename = None
+    if file and file.filename:
+        file_bytes = file.file.read()
+        original_filename = file.filename
+
+    project_id = uuid.UUID(associated_project_id) if associated_project_id else None
+    token_id = uuid.UUID(associated_token_id) if associated_token_id else None
+    author_uuid = uuid.UUID(author_id) if author_id else current_user.id
+
+    drn = drn_service.create_drn(
+        db=db,
+        doc_type=doc_type_enum.value,
+        date=datetime.fromisoformat(date),
+        associated_project_id=project_id,
+        associated_token_id=token_id,
+        author_id=author_uuid,
+        document_nature=document_nature_enum.value,
+        intended_user=intended_user_enum.value,
+        description=description,
+        revision=revision,
+        status=status_enum.value,
+        remarks=remarks,
+        file_bytes=file_bytes,
+        original_filename=original_filename,
+    )
+
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.get("/drns", response_model=DRNListResponse)
+def list_drns(
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+    project_id: str | None = Query(None),
+    token_id: str | None = Query(None),
+    doc_type: str | None = Query(None),
+    status: str | None = Query(None),
+    page: int = Query(default=1, ge=1),
+    page_size: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100),
+):
+    project_uuid = uuid.UUID(project_id) if project_id else None
+    token_uuid = uuid.UUID(token_id) if token_id else None
+
+    items, total = drn_service.list_drns(
+        db,
+        project_id=project_uuid,
+        token_id=token_uuid,
+        doc_type=doc_type,
+        status=status,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+    return DRNListResponse(
+        items=[DRNRead.model_validate(d) for d in items],
+        total=total,
+        page=page,
+        page_size=page_size,
+    )
+
+
+@router.get("/drns/{drn_id}", response_model=DRNRead)
+def get_drn(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    drn = drn_service.get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.patch("/drns/{drn_id}", response_model=DRNRead)
+def update_drn(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    update_data: DRNUpdate,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    drn = drn_service.update_drn(db, drn_id, **update_data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True))
+    if not drn:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.delete("/drns/{drn_id}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
+def delete_drn(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    success = drn_service.delete_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not success:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+
+
+@router.post("/drns/{drn_id}/transition-status", response_model=DRNRead)
+def transition_status(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    new_status: str = Form(...),
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    try:
+        status_enum = DRNStatus(new_status)
+    except ValueError as err:
+        raise HTTPException(
+            status_code=400,
+            detail=f"Invalid status. Must be one of: {', '.join(e.value for e in DRNStatus)}",
+        ) from err
+
+    drn = drn_service.transition_status(db, drn_id, status_enum.value)
+    if not drn:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="DRN not found")
+    return DRNRead.model_validate(drn)
+
+
+@router.get("/drns/{drn_id}/download")
+def download_file(
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    _: User = Depends(get_current_user),
+    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
+):
+    file_path = drn_service.get_file_path(db, drn_id)
+    if not file_path:
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="File not found")
+
+    path = Path(file_path)
+    if not path.exists():
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, detail="File not found on disk")
+
+    return FileResponse(
+        path=path,
+        media_type="application/octet-stream",
+        filename=f"drn_{drn_id}.file",
+    )

+"""Base CRUD service helper for HR bundle modules.
+
+Provides common CRUD operations for HR-related entities.
+"""
+
+import uuid
+from typing import Any, Generic, TypeVar
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
+
+T = TypeVar("T")
+
+
+class BaseCRUDService(Generic[T]):
+    """Base CRUD service for HR entities."""
+
+    def __init__(self, repo_module):
+        self.repo = repo_module
+
+    def list_items(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        page: int = 1,
+        page_size: int = 20,
+        q: str | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[list[T], int, int, int]:
+        """List items with pagination and search."""
+        items, total = self.repo.list_items(db, page, page_size, q)
+        return items, total, page, page_size
+
+    def get_item(self, db: Session, item_id: uuid.UUID) -> T | None:
+        """Get item by ID."""
+        return self.repo.get_by_id(db, item_id)
+
+    def create_item(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        data: Any,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> T:
+        """Create item with audit logging."""
+        item = self.repo.create(db, **kwargs)
+
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action=f"{self._get_entity_type()}.create",
+            entity_type=self._get_entity_type(),
+            entity_id=item.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            after_json={
+                "id": str(item.id),
+                **self._get_audit_fields(item),
+            },
+        )
+
+        return item
+
+    def update_item(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        item_id: uuid.UUID,
+        data: Any,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> T | None:
+        """Update item with audit logging."""
+        item = self.get_item(db, item_id)
+        if not item:
+            return None
+
+        before_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        for key, value in kwargs.items():
+            if hasattr(item, key):
+                setattr(item, key, value)
+
+        self.repo.update(db, item)
+
+        after_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action=f"{self._get_entity_type()}.update",
+            entity_type=self._get_entity_type(),
+            entity_id=item.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            before_json=before_json,
+            after_json=after_json,
+        )
+
+        return item
+
+    def delete_item(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        item_id: uuid.UUID,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+    ) -> bool:
+        """Delete item (soft delete) with audit logging."""
+        item = self.get_item(db, item_id)
+        if not item:
+            return False
+
+        before_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        self.repo.soft_delete(db, item)
+
+        after_json = self._get_audit_fields(item)
+
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action=f"{self._get_entity_type()}.delete",
+            entity_type=self._get_entity_type(),
+            entity_id=item.id,
+            user_id=actor_id,
+            before_json=before_json,
+            after_json=after_json,
+        )
+
+        return True
+
+    def _get_entity_type(self) -> str:
+        """Get entity type for audit logging. Override in subclasses."""
+        return "item"
+
+    def _get_audit_fields(self, item: T) -> dict:
+        """Get fields for audit logging. Override in subclasses."""
+        return {"id": str(item.id)}

+"""Local filesystem storage helper for DRN files.
+
+Provides file upload, retrieval, and deletion utilities for DRN documents.
+"""
+
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+
+UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
+MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
+ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}
+
+
+CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
+    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
+    ".dwg": "application/acad",
+    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
+    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
+    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".png": "image/png",
+    ".zip": "application/zip",
+}
+
+
+def save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    """Save a file for a DRN.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code (e.g., SWA-2025-DBR-001)
+        original_name: Original filename
+        file_bytes: File content as bytes
+
+    Returns:
+        Tuple of (file_path, mime_type)
+    """
+    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
+    if ext not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS:
+        raise ValueError(f"Invalid file type. Allowed: {', '.join(sorted(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS))}")
+
+    if len(file_bytes) > MAX_FILE_SIZE:
+        raise ValueError("File exceeds 50MB limit")
+
+    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path = d / safe_name
+    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
+    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
+    return str(path), mime
+
+
+def get_file_path(drn_code: str, filename: str) -> str | None:
+    """Get the full path for a DRN file.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code
+        filename: The filename
+
+    Returns:
+        Full file path or None if not found
+    """
+    path = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code / filename
+    return str(path) if path.exists() else None
+
+
+def delete_file(drn_code: str, filename: str) -> bool:
+    """Delete a DRN file.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code
+        filename: The filename
+
+    Returns:
+        True if file was deleted, False if it didn't exist
+    """
+    path = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code / filename
+    if path.exists():
+        path.unlink()
+        return True
+    return False
+
+
+def list_files(drn_code: str) -> list[str]:
+    """List all files for a DRN.
+
+    Args:
+        drn_code: The DRN code
+
+    Returns:
+        List of filenames
+    """
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
+    if not d.exists():
+        return []
+
+    return [f.name for f in d.iterdir() if f.is_file()]

+import uuid
+from datetime import date

+
+from src.backend.models.time_log import TimeLog
+
+
+def get_by_id(db: Session, time_log_id: uuid.UUID) -> TimeLog | None:
+    return db.query(TimeLog).filter(TimeLog.id == time_log_id).first()
+
+
+def list_time_logs(
+    db: Session,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+    q: str | None = None,
+    employee_id: str | None = None,
+    work_type: str | None = None,
+    start_date: date | None = None,
+    end_date: date | None = None,
+) -> tuple[list[TimeLog], int]:
+    query = db.query(TimeLog)
+
+    if q:
+        search = f"%{q}%"
+        query = query.filter(
+            TimeLog.project_name.ilike(search)
+            | TimeLog.reference_id.ilike(search)
+            | TimeLog.remarks.ilike(search)
+        )
+
+    if employee_id:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.employee_id == employee_id)
+
+    if work_type:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.work_type == work_type)
+
+    if start_date:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.log_date >= start_date)
+
+    if end_date:
+        query = query.filter(TimeLog.log_date <= end_date)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(TimeLog.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return list(items), total
+
+
+def create(db: Session, data: dict) -> TimeLog:
+    time_log = TimeLog(**data)
+    db.add(time_log)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(time_log)
+    return time_log
+
+
+def update(db: Session, time_log: TimeLog, data: dict) -> TimeLog:
+    for key, value in data.items():
+        setattr(time_log, key, value)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(time_log)
+    return time_log
+
+
+def delete(db: Session, time_log: TimeLog) -> None:
+    db.delete(time_log)
+    db.commit()

+        items, total, page, page_size = self.list_items(db, page, page_size, q)
+        return items, total, page, page_size
+
+    def create_process_service(
+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        data: AdminProcessCreate,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+    ) -> AdminProcess:
+        """Create process with audit logging."""
+        return self.create_item(
+            db,
+            data,
+            actor_id,
+            process_id=data.process_id,
+            process_name=data.process_name,
+            process_category=data.process_category,
+            frequency=data.frequency,
+            is_digitized=data.is_digitized,
+            digitization_type=data.digitization_type,
+            tool_used=data.tool_used,
+            owner=data.owner,
+            last_updated_date=data.last_updated_date,
+            notes=data.notes,
+        )

+        return self.get_item(db, process_id)

+        self,
+        db: Session,
+        process_id: uuid.UUID,
+        data: AdminProcessUpdate,
+        actor_id: uuid.UUID | None,
+    ) -> AdminProcess | None:
+        """Update process with audit logging."""
+        kwargs = {}
+        if data.process_id is not None:
+            kwargs["process_id"] = data.process_id
+        if data.process_name is not None:
+            kwargs["process_name"] = data.process_name

+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
+from src.backend.models.drn import DRN
+
+UPLOAD_DIR = Path("uploads/drn")
+MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024
+ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = {".pdf", ".dwg", ".docx", ".xlsx", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".zip"}
+
+
+CONTENT_TYPE_MAP = {
+    ".pdf": "application/pdf",
+    ".dwg": "application/acad",
+    ".docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
+    ".xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
+    ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".jpeg": "image/jpeg",
+    ".png": "image/png",
+    ".zip": "application/zip",
+}
+
+
+def _ensure_dir(drn_code: str) -> Path:
+    d = UPLOAD_DIR / drn_code
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    return d
+
+
+def _save_file(drn_code: str, original_name: str, file_bytes: bytes) -> tuple[str, str]:
+    ext = Path(original_name).suffix.lower()
+    safe_name = f"{uuid.uuid4().hex}_{original_name}"
+    d = _ensure_dir(drn_code)
+    path = d / safe_name
+    path.write_bytes(file_bytes)
+    mime = CONTENT_TYPE_MAP.get(ext, "application/octet-stream")
+    return str(path), mime
+
+
+def create_drn(
+    db: Session,
+    doc_type: str,
+    date: datetime,
+    associated_project_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    associated_token_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    author_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
+    document_nature: str = "Internal",
+    intended_user: str = "Internal",
+    description: str = "",
+    revision: str = "R0",
+    status: str = "Draft",
+    remarks: str | None = None,
+    file_bytes: bytes | None = None,
+    original_filename: str | None = None,
+) -> DRN:
+    drn_code = next_business_id(db, doc_type, year=0)
+
+    file_path = None
+    if file_bytes and original_filename:
+        file_path, _ = _save_file(drn_code, original_filename, file_bytes)
+
+    drn = DRN(
+        drn_code=drn_code,
+        doc_type=doc_type,
+        date=date,
+        associated_project_id=associated_project_id,
+        associated_token_id=associated_token_id,
+        author_id=author_id,
+        document_nature=document_nature,
+        intended_user=intended_user,
+        description=description,
+        revision=revision,
+        status=status,
+        remarks=remarks,
+        file_path=file_path,
+    )
+    db.add(drn)
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(drn)
+    return drn
+
+
+def list_drns(
+    db: Session,
+    project_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    token_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    doc_type: Optional[str] = None,
+    status: Optional[str] = None,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[DRN], int]:
+    query = db.query(DRN).filter(not DRN.is_deleted)
+
+    if project_id:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_project_id == project_id)
+    if token_id:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.associated_token_id == token_id)
+    if doc_type:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.doc_type == doc_type)
+    if status:
+        query = query.filter(DRN.status == status)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.order_by(DRN.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return items, total
+
+
+def get_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> Optional[DRN]:
+    return db.query(DRN).filter(DRN.id == drn_id, not DRN.is_deleted).first()
+
+
+def update_drn(
+    db: Session,
+    drn_id: uuid.UUID,
+    **kwargs,
+) -> DRN | None:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return None
+
+    for key, value in kwargs.items():
+        if hasattr(drn, key) and value is not None:
+            setattr(drn, key, value)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(drn)
+    return drn
+
+
+def delete_drn(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return False
+
+    drn.is_deleted = True
+    db.commit()
+    return True
+
+
+def transition_status(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID, new_status: str) -> DRN | None:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return None
+
+    drn.status = new_status
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(drn)
+    return drn
+
+
+def get_file_path(db: Session, drn_id: uuid.UUID) -> str | None:
+    drn = get_drn(db, drn_id)
+    if not drn:
+        return None
+    return drn.file_path

+import uuid

+

+

+from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
+from src.backend.models.token import Token, TokenStatus

+
+
+class TokenServiceError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def can_transition_status(from_status: str, to_status: str) -> bool:
+    allowed_transitions = {
+        TokenStatus.IN_PROGRESS: {
+            TokenStatus.CLOSED,
+            TokenStatus.UNDER_REVIEW,
+            TokenStatus.CANCELLED,
+        },
+        TokenStatus.CLOSED: {
+            TokenStatus.UNDER_REVIEW,
+            TokenStatus.CANCELLED,
+        },
+        TokenStatus.UNDER_REVIEW: {
+            TokenStatus.IN_PROGRESS,
+            TokenStatus.CLOSED,
+            TokenStatus.CANCELLED,
+        },
+        TokenStatus.CANCELLED: set(),
+    }
+
+    return to_status in allowed_transitions.get(from_status, set())
+
+
+def create_token(
+    db: Session,
+    token_date: datetime,
+    agreement_id: uuid.UUID,
+    token_type: str,
+    description: Optional[str] = None,
+    token_status: Optional[str] = None,
+    tokens_used: Optional[Decimal] = None,
+    swa_team_lead: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    project_owner: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    client_employee_name: Optional[str] = None,
+    client_employee_email: Optional[str] = None,
+    notes: Optional[str] = None,
+    created_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> Token:
+    current_year = datetime.utcnow().year
+
+    token = Token(
+        token_date=token_date,
+        agreement_id=agreement_id,
+        token_type=token_type,
+        description=description,
+        token_status=token_status or TokenStatus.IN_PROGRESS.value,
+        tokens_used=tokens_used,
+        swa_team_lead=swa_team_lead,
+        project_owner=project_owner,
+        client_employee_name=client_employee_name,
+        client_employee_email=client_employee_email,
+        notes=notes,
+    )
+
+    db.add(token)
+    db.flush()
+
+    token.token_id = next_business_id(db, "TKN", current_year)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(token)
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="token.create",
+        entity_type="token",
+        entity_id=token.id,
+        user_id=created_by,
+        after_json={
+            "token_id": token.token_id,
+            "agreement_id": str(agreement_id),
+            "token_type": token_type,
+            "token_status": token.token_status,
+            "tokens_used": float(tokens_used) if tokens_used else None,
+        },
+    )
+
+    return token
+
+
+def get_token(db: Session, token_id: uuid.UUID) -> Token | None:
+    return db.query(Token).filter(Token.id == token_id).first()
+
+
+def list_tokens(
+    db: Session,
+    agreement_id: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+    token_status: Optional[str] = None,
+    page: int = 1,
+    page_size: int = 20,
+) -> tuple[list[Token], int]:
+    query = db.query(Token)
+
+    if agreement_id:
+        query = query.filter(Token.agreement_id == agreement_id)
+
+    if token_status:
+        query = query.filter(Token.token_status == token_status)
+
+    total = query.count()
+    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
+    items = query.offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()
+
+    return items, total
+
+
+def update_token(
+    db: Session,
+    token_id: uuid.UUID,
+    update_data: dict,
+    updated_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> Token | None:
+    token = get_token(db, token_id)
+    if not token:
+        return None
+
+    old_status = token.token_status
+    for key, value in update_data.items():
+        if hasattr(token, key) and value is not None:
+            setattr(token, key, value)
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(token)
+
+    if old_status != token.token_status:
+        create_entry(
+            db,
+            action="token.status_transition",
+            entity_type="token",
+            entity_id=token.id,
+            user_id=updated_by,
+            after_json={
+                "token_id": token.token_id,
+                "from_status": old_status,
+                "to_status": token.token_status,
+            },
+        )
+
+    return token
+
+
+def delete_token(
+    db: Session,
+    token_id: uuid.UUID,
+    deleted_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> bool:
+    token = get_token(db, token_id)
+    if not token:
+        return False
+
+    token_status = token.token_status
+    if token_status not in {TokenStatus.CANCELLED, TokenStatus.CLOSED}:
+        raise TokenServiceError(
+            f"Cannot delete token with status '{token_status}'. "
+            "Only 'Cancelled' or 'Closed' tokens can be deleted."
+        )
+
+    db.delete(token)
+    db.commit()
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="token.delete",
+        entity_type="token",
+        entity_id=token_id,
+        user_id=deleted_by,
+        after_json={
+            "token_id": token.token_id,
+            "token_status": token_status,
+        },
+    )
+
+    return True
+
+
+def transition_token_status(
+    db: Session,
+    token_id: uuid.UUID,
+    new_status: str,
+    transitioned_by: Optional[uuid.UUID] = None,
+) -> Token | None:
+    token = get_token(db, token_id)
+    if not token:
+        return None
+
+    if not can_transition_status(token.token_status, new_status):
+        raise TokenServiceError(
+            f"Invalid status transition from '{token.token_status}' to '{new_status}'"
+        )
+
+    old_status = token.token_status
+    token.token_status = new_status
+
+    if new_status == TokenStatus.CLOSED and token.tokens_used:
+        agreement = (
+            db.query(ServiceAgreement)
+            .filter(ServiceAgreement.id == token.agreement_id)
+            .first()
+        )
+        if agreement:
+            agreement.total_tokens = (
+                (agreement.total_tokens or 0) + float(token.tokens_used)
+            )
+            db.commit()
+
+    db.commit()
+    db.refresh(token)
+
+    create_entry(
+        db,
+        action="token.status_transition",
+        entity_type="token",
+        entity_id=token.id,
+        user_id=transitioned_by,
+        after_json={
+            "token_id": token.token_id,
+            "from_status": old_status,
+            "to_status": new_status,
+            "tokens_used": float(token.tokens_used) if token.tokens_used else None,
+        },
+    )
+
+    return token
+
+
+def get_tokens_by_agreement(db: Session, agreement_id: uuid.UUID) -> list[Token]:
+    return db.query(Token).filter(Token.agreement_id == agreement_id).all()

import uuid
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.project_repo import (
    create_project,
    get_project_with_names,
    list_projects_with_names,
    soft_delete_project,
    update_project,
)
from src.backend.db.repositories.project_repo import (
    get_by_id as get_project_by_id,
)
from src.backend.models.project import Project
from src.backend.schemas.project import Milestone, ProjectCreate, ProjectUpdate


def create_project_service(
    db: Session,
    data: ProjectCreate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = data.model_dump()
    if not payload.get("business_id"):
        payload["business_id"] = next_business_id(db, "PRJ")
    if not payload.get("milestone"):
        payload["milestone"] = Milestone.CONCEPT.value
    project = create_project(db, payload)

    result = get_project_with_names(db, project.id)
    if result:
        record_event(
            db,
            action="project.create",
            entity_type="project",
            user_id=actor_id,
            entity_id=project.id,
            after_json=_project_to_dict(project),
        )

    return result


def get_project_service(db: Session, project_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    return get_project_with_names(db, project_id)


def list_projects_service(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    milestone: str | None = None,
    team_leader: uuid.UUID | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int, int, int]:
    return list_projects_with_names(
        db,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        q=q,
        status=status,
        milestone=milestone,
        team_leader=team_leader,
    )


def update_project_service(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: ProjectUpdate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    project = get_project_by_id(db, project_id)
    if not project:
        return None

    before_json = _project_to_dict(project)

    update_data = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    update_project(db, project_id, update_data)

    project = get_project_by_id(db, project_id)
    after_json = _project_to_dict(project)

    record_event(
        db,
        action="project.update",
        entity_type="project",
        user_id=actor_id,
        entity_id=project_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return get_project_with_names(db, project_id)


def soft_delete_project_service(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> bool:
    project = get_project_by_id(db, project_id)
    if not project:
        return False

    before_json = _project_to_dict(project)

    success = soft_delete_project(db, project_id)

    if success:
        record_event(
            db,
            action="project.delete",
            entity_type="project",
            user_id=actor_id,
            entity_id=project_id,
            before_json=before_json,
        )

    return success


def record_event(
    db: Session,
    action: str,
    entity_type: str,
    user_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    entity_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    before_json: dict | None = None,
    after_json: dict | None = None,
) -> None:
    create_entry(
        db,
        action=action,
        entity_type=entity_type,
        user_id=user_id,
        entity_id=entity_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )


def _project_to_dict(project: Project) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": str(project.id),
        "client_id": str(project.client_id),
        "name": project.name,
        "code": project.code,
        "description": project.description,
        "status": project.status,
        "pm_id": str(project.pm_id) if project.pm_id else None,
        "designer_id": str(project.designer_id) if project.designer_id else None,
        "auditor_id": str(project.auditor_id) if project.auditor_id else None,
        "location": project.location,
        "estimated_value": str(project.estimated_value) if project.estimated_value else None,
        "actual_value": str(project.actual_value) if project.actual_value else None,
        "start_date": str(project.start_date) if project.start_date else None,
        "target_end_date": str(project.target_end_date) if project.target_end_date else None,
        "actual_end_date": str(project.actual_end_date) if project.actual_end_date else None,
        "is_active": project.is_active,
        "business_id": project.business_id,
        "milestone": project.milestone,
        "progress_indicators": project.progress_indicators,
        "status_updates": project.status_updates,
        "team_leader_id": str(project.team_leader_id) if project.team_leader_id else None,
        "project_owner_id": str(project.project_owner_id) if project.project_owner_id else None,
        "notes": project.notes,
    }

display.text:
"""Business-ID generator.

Produces IDs like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`. Uses a DB-backed sequence counter
(`IdSequence`) so each (type_code, year) pair advances atomically.

Pass `year=0` for "continuous across years" (per meeting: DBR/CAS/GAD numbers
do not reset per year).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.id_sequence import IdSequence


def current_year() -> int:
    return datetime.utcnow().year


def next_business_id(db: Session, type_code: str, year: int | None = None) -> str:
    """Generate the next business ID for `type_code`.

    Args:
        db: SQLAlchemy session.
        type_code: Short code like `CLT`, `INQ`, `SA`, `TKN`, `PRJ`, `EMP`,
            `FDB`, `TRN`, `HW`, `PROC`, `COL`, `INN`, `FB`, `CMP`,
            `IG`, `LI`, `WEB`, `CON`, `DBR`, `CAS`, `GAD`, `KDR`, `RDP`,
            `VAL`, `RPT`, `OTH`.
        year: Calendar year (defaults to current year). Pass `0` for
            continuous counters (e.g. DBR numbers per the meeting transcript).

    Returns:
        A formatted ID string like `SWA-2025-CLT-001`.
    """
    if year is None:
        year = current_year()

    seq = (
        db.query(IdSequence)
        .filter_by(type_code=type_code, year=year)
        .with_for_update()
        .one_or_none()
    )
    if seq is None:
        seq = IdSequence(type_code=type_code, year=year, last_value=0)
        db.add(seq)
        db.flush()

    seq.last_value += 1
    db.flush()

    return f"SWA-{year}-{type_code}-{seq.last_value:03d}"

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import StrEnum

from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Date, DateTime, ForeignKey, Index, Numeric, String, Text, func  # noqa: I001
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import JSONB, UUID
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column, relationship

from src.backend.db.base import Base


class Milestone(StrEnum):
    CONCEPT = "Concept"
    DBR = "DBR"
    CALCULATION = "Calculation"
    DRAWING = "Drawing"
    VALIDATION = "Validation"
    CLOSEOUT = "Closeout"


class Project(Base):
    __tablename__ = "projects"
    id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), primary_key=True, default=uuid.uuid4)
    client_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("clients.id"), nullable=False, index=True)
    name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    code: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), unique=True, nullable=False, index=True)
    description: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=False, default="Lead")
    pm_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True, index=True)
    designer_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True, index=True)
    auditor_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True, index=True)
    location: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=True)
    estimated_value: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(18, 2), nullable=True)
    actual_value: Mapped[Decimal | None] = mapped_column(Numeric(18, 2), nullable=True)
    start_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    target_end_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    actual_end_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    is_active: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False, default=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), nullable=False)
    updated_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), server_default=func.now(), onupdate=func.now(), nullable=False)
    deleted_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)

    business_id: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(64), nullable=True)
    milestone: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(String(50), nullable=True, default=Milestone.CONCEPT.value)
    progress_indicators: Mapped[dict | None] = mapped_column(JSONB, nullable=True)
    status_updates: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    team_leader_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(
        UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True
    )
    project_owner_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(
        UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True
    )
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)

    __table_args__ = (
        Index("ix_projects_business_id", "business_id", unique=True),
        Index("ix_projects_milestone", "milestone"),
        Index("ix_projects_team_leader_id", "team_leader_id"),
        Index("ix_projects_project_owner_id", "project_owner_id"),
    )

    tasks: Mapped[list["Task"]] = relationship("Task", back_populates="project", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
    compliance_checklists: Mapped[list["ComplianceChecklist"]] = relationship(
        "ComplianceChecklist", back_populates="project", cascade="all, delete-orphan"
    )

import uuid
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.project_repo import (
    create_project,
    get_project_with_names,
    list_projects_with_names,
    soft_delete_project,
    update_project,
)
from src.backend.db.repositories.project_repo import (
    get_by_id as get_project_by_id,
)
from src.backend.models.project import Project
from src.backend.schemas.project import Milestone, ProjectCreate, ProjectUpdate


def create_project_service(
    db: Session,
    data: ProjectCreate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = data.model_dump()
    if not payload.get("business_id"):
        payload["business_id"] = next_business_id(db, "PRJ")
    if not payload.get("milestone"):
        payload["milestone"] = Milestone.CONCEPT.value
    project = create_project(db, payload)

    result = get_project_with_names(db, project.id)
    if result:
        record_event(
            db,
            action="project.create",
            entity_type="project",
            user_id=actor_id,
            entity_id=project.id,
            after_json=_project_to_dict(project),
        )

    return result


def get_project_service(db: Session, project_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    return get_project_with_names(db, project_id)


def list_projects_service(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    milestone: str | None = None,
    team_leader: uuid.UUID | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int, int, int]:
    return list_projects_with_names(
        db,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        q=q,
        status=status,
        milestone=milestone,
        team_leader=team_leader,
    )


def update_project_service(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: ProjectUpdate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    project = get_project_by_id(db, project_id)
    if not project:
        return None

    before_json = _project_to_dict(project)

    update_data = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    update_project(db, project_id, update_data)

    project = get_project_by_id(db, project_id)
    after_json = _project_to_dict(project)

    record_event(
        db,
        action="project.update",
        entity_type="project",
        user_id=actor_id,
        entity_id=project_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return get_project_with_names(db, project_id)


def soft_delete_project_service(
    db: Session,
    project_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> bool:
    project = get_project_by_id(db, project_id)
    if not project:
        return False

    before_json = _project_to_dict(project)

    success = soft_delete_project(db, project_id)

    if success:
        record_event(
            db,
            action="project.delete",
            entity_type="project",
            user_id=actor_id,
            entity_id=project_id,
            before_json=before_json,
        )

    return success


def record_event(
    db: Session,
    action: str,
    entity_type: str,
    user_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    entity_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    before_json: dict | None = None,
    after_json: dict | None = None,
) -> None:
    create_entry(
        db,
        action=action,
        entity_type=entity_type,
        user_id=user_id,
        entity_id=entity_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )


def _project_to_dict(project: Project) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": str(project.id),
        "client_id": str(project.client_id),
        "name": project.name,
        "code": project.code,
        "description": project.description,
        "status": project.status,
        "pm_id": str(project.pm_id) if project.pm_id else None,
        "designer_id": str(project.designer_id) if project.designer_id else None,
        "auditor_id": str(project.auditor_id) if project.auditor_id else None,
        "location": project.location,
        "estimated_value": str(project.estimated_value) if project.estimated_value else None,
        "actual_value": str(project.actual_value) if project.actual_value else None,
        "start_date": str(project.start_date) if project.start_date else None,
        "target_end_date": str(project.target_end_date) if project.target_end_date else None,
        "actual_end_date": str(project.actual_end_date) if project.actual_end_date else None,
        "is_active": project.is_active,
        "business_id": project.business_id,
        "milestone": project.milestone,
        "progress_indicators": project.progress_indicators,
        "status_updates": project.status_updates,
        "team_leader_id": str(project.team_leader_id) if project.team_leader_id else None,

"""Wave 9 / Agent Epsilon — Project Tracking module tests."""
from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime

import pytest

pytestmark = pytest.mark.asyncio


async def _create_client(authed_admin_client, code: str = "PTC-001", name: str = "PTClient") -> str:
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/clients",
        json={"name": name, "code": code, "primary_email": f"{code.lower()}@example.com"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    return r.json()["id"]


async def test_business_id_auto_generated(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="BIZ-001")
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={
            "client_id": client_id,
            "name": "BizProj",
            "code": "BP-001",
            "status": "Lead",
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    body = r.json()
    year = datetime.utcnow().year
    assert body["business_id"] == f"SWA-{year}-PRJ-001"
    assert body["milestone"] == "Concept"


async def test_business_id_increments(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="INC-001")
    year = datetime.utcnow().year
    ids = []
    for i in range(3):
        r = await authed_admin_client.post(
            "/api/projects",
            json={
                "client_id": client_id,
                "name": f"IncProj{i}",
                "code": f"IN-{i:03d}",
                "status": "Lead",
            },
        )
        assert r.status_code == 201
        ids.append(r.json()["business_id"])
    assert ids == [
        f"SWA-{year}-PRJ-001",
        f"SWA-{year}-PRJ-002",
        f"SWA-{year}-PRJ-003",
    ]


async def test_milestone_filter(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="MF-001")
    await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={"client_id": client_id, "name": "ConceptProj", "code": "MF-A", "milestone": "Concept"},
    )
    await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={"client_id": client_id, "name": "DrawingProj", "code": "MF-B", "milestone": "Drawing"},
    )

    r = await authed_admin_client.get("/api/projects?milestone=Concept")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    items = r.json()["items"]
    assert len(items) >= 1
    assert all(p["milestone"] == "Concept" for p in items)
    codes = {p["code"] for p in items}
    assert "MF-A" in codes
    assert "MF-B" not in codes


async def test_team_leader_filter(authed_admin_client, db_session, admin_user, pm_user):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="TLF-001")

    r1 = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={
            "client_id": client_id,
            "name": "AdminLed",
            "code": "TLF-A",
            "team_leader_id": str(admin_user.id),
        },
    )
    assert r1.status_code == 201

    r2 = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={
            "client_id": client_id,
            "name": "PMLed",
            "code": "TLF-B",
            "team_leader_id": str(pm_user.id),
        },
    )
    assert r2.status_code == 201

    r = await authed_admin_client.get(f"/api/projects?team_leader={admin_user.id}")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    codes = {p["code"] for p in r.json()["items"]}
    assert "TLF-A" in codes
    assert "TLF-B" not in codes


async def test_progress_indicators_round_trip(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="PI-001")
    indicators = {"design_pct": 30, "calc_pct": 10, "drawing_pct": 0}

    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={
            "client_id": client_id,
            "name": "PIProj",
            "code": "PI-1",
            "progress_indicators": indicators,
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    pid = r.json()["id"]
    assert r.json()["progress_indicators"] == indicators

    r2 = await authed_admin_client.get(f"/api/projects/{pid}")
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.json()["progress_indicators"] == indicators


async def test_update_milestone_and_notes(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="UM-001")
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={"client_id": client_id, "name": "UMProj", "code": "UM-1"},
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201
    pid = r.json()["id"]

    r2 = await authed_admin_client.patch(
        f"/api/projects/{pid}",
        json={
            "milestone": "Calculation",
            "notes": "In progress",
            "status_updates": "Kickoff done",
        },
    )
    assert r2.status_code == 200, r2.text
    body = r2.json()
    assert body["milestone"] == "Calculation"
    assert body["notes"] == "In progress"
    assert body["status_updates"] == "Kickoff done"


async def test_team_leader_and_owner_attached(authed_admin_client, db_session, admin_user, pm_user):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="TA-001")
    r = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={
            "client_id": client_id,
            "name": "TAProj",
            "code": "TA-1",
            "team_leader_id": str(admin_user.id),
            "project_owner_id": str(pm_user.id),
        },
    )
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    body = r.json()
    assert body["team_leader_id"] == str(admin_user.id)
    assert body["project_owner_id"] == str(pm_user.id)
    assert body["team_leader_name"] == "Admin"
    assert body["project_owner_name"] == "PM"


async def test_business_id_unique(authed_admin_client, db_session):
    client_id = await _create_client(authed_admin_client, code="UQ-001")
    r1 = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={"client_id": client_id, "name": "UQ1", "code": "UQ-A", "business_id": "SWA-CUSTOM-001"},
    )
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    r2 = await authed_admin_client.post(
        "/api/projects",
        json={"client_id": client_id, "name": "UQ2", "code": "UQ-B", "business_id": "SWA-CUSTOM-001"},
    )
    assert r2.status_code == 409


async def test_milestone_enum_exported(db_session):
    from src.backend.models.project import Milestone

    assert Milestone.CONCEPT.value == "Concept"
    assert Milestone.DBR.value == "DBR"
    assert Milestone.CALCULATION.value == "Calculation"
    assert Milestone.DRAWING.value == "Drawing"
    assert Milestone.VALIDATION.value == "Validation"
    assert Milestone.CLOSEOUT.value == "Closeout"

import uuid
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.sustainability_repo import (
    create as create_sustainability,
    get_by_id as get_sustainability_by_id,
    list_sustainability,
    soft_delete as soft_delete_sustainability,
    update as update_sustainability,
)
from src.backend.db.repositories.sustainability_repo import (
    get_by_reference_id as get_sustainability_by_reference_id,
)
from src.backend.models.sustainability import SustainabilityMetric
from src.backend.schemas.sustainability import SustainabilityCreate, SustainabilityUpdate


def create_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    data: SustainabilityCreate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = data.model_dump()
    sustainability = create_sustainability(db, payload)

    result = get_sustainability_by_reference_id(db, sustainability.reference_id)
    if result:
        record_event(
            db,
            action="sustainability.create",
            entity_type="sustainability",
            user_id=actor_id,
            entity_id=sustainability.id,
            after_json=_sustainability_to_dict(result),
        )

    return result


def get_sustainability_service(db: Session, sustainability_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    return get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)


def list_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    reference_kind: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int, int, int]:
    return list_sustainability(
        db,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        q=q,
        reference_kind=reference_kind,
    )


def update_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    sustainability_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: SustainabilityUpdate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    sustainability = get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)
    if not sustainability:
        return None

    before_json = _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability)

    update_data = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    update_sustainability(db, sustainability_id, update_data)

    sustainability = get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)
    after_json = _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability)

    record_event(
        db,
        action="sustainability.update",
        entity_type="sustainability",
        user_id=actor_id,
        entity_id=sustainability_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return get_sustainability_by_reference_id(db, sustainability.reference_id)


def soft_delete_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    sustainability_id: uuid.UUID,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> bool:
    sustainability = get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)
    if not sustainability:
        return False

    before_json = _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability)

    success = soft_delete_sustainability(db, sustainability_id)

    if success:
        record_event(
            db,
            action="sustainability.delete",
            entity_type="sustainability",
            user_id=actor_id,
            entity_id=sustainability_id,
            before_json=before_json,
        )

    return success


def get_sustainability_dashboard(db: Session) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from sqlalchemy import func

    result = db.query(
        func.sum(SustainabilityMetric.total_energy_saved_kwh).label("total_energy_saved_kwh"),
        func.sum(SustainabilityMetric.co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e).label("total_co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e"),
        func.avg(SustainabilityMetric.insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected).label("average_insulation_efficiency"),
    ).first()

    return {
        "total_energy_saved_kwh": result.total_energy_saved_kwh,
        "total_co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e": result.total_co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e,
        "average_insulation_efficiency": result.average_insulation_efficiency,
    }


def record_event(
    db: Session,
    action: str,
    entity_type: str,
    user_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    entity_id: uuid.UUID | None = None,
    before_json: dict | None = None,
    after_json: dict | None = None,
) -> None:
    create_entry(

        entity_type=entity_type,
        user_id=user_id,
        entity_id=entity_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.client import Client


def list_clients(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = None,
    industry: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[Client], int]:
    query = db.query(Client).filter(Client.deleted_at.is_(None))

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(
            Client.name.ilike(search) | Client.code.ilike(search) | Client.primary_email.ilike(search)
        )

    if status:
        query = query.filter(Client.client_status == status)

    if industry:
        query = query.filter(Client.industry == industry)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(Client.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def get_by_id(db: Session, client_id: uuid.UUID) -> Client | None:
    return db.query(Client).filter(Client.id == client_id, Client.deleted_at.is_(None)).first()


def create(
    db: Session,
    name: str,
    code: str,
    primary_email: str,
    address: str | None = None,
    city: str | None = None,
    state: str | None = None,
    pincode: str | None = None,
    country: str = "India",
    gst_number: str | None = None,
    primary_phone: str | None = None,
    notes: str | None = None,
    business_id: str | None = None,
    industry: str | None = None,
    date_onboarded: date | None = None,
    client_status: str = "Active",
    first_lead_id: str | None = None,
    first_inquiry_id: str | None = None,
) -> Client:
    client = Client(
        name=name,
        code=code,
        primary_email=primary_email,
        address=address,
        city=city,
        state=state,
        pincode=pincode,
        country=country,
        gst_number=gst_number,
        primary_phone=primary_phone,
        notes=notes,
        business_id=business_id,
        industry=industry,
        date_onboarded=date_onboarded,
        client_status=client_status,
        first_lead_id=first_lead_id,
        first_inquiry_id=first_inquiry_id,
    )
    db.add(client)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client


def update(db: Session, client: Client) -> Client:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client


def soft_delete(db: Session, client: Client) -> Client:
    client.deleted_at = datetime.utcnow()
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(client)
    return client

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.sustainability import SustainabilityMetric


def list_sustainability(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    reference_kind: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[SustainabilityMetric], int]:
    query = db.query(SustainabilityMetric)

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(
            SustainabilityMetric.reference_id.ilike(search)
            | SustainabilityMetric.compliant_with_green_standards.ilike(search)
            | SustainabilityMetric.notes.ilike(search)
        )

    if reference_kind:
        query = query.filter(SustainabilityMetric.reference_kind == reference_kind)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(SustainabilityMetric.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def get_by_id(db: Session, sustainability_id: uuid.UUID) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    return db.query(SustainabilityMetric).filter(SustainabilityMetric.id == sustainability_id).first()


def get_by_reference_id(db: Session, reference_id: str) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    return db.query(SustainabilityMetric).filter(SustainabilityMetric.reference_id == reference_id).first()


def create(
    db: Session,
    reference_id: str,
    reference_kind: str,
    compliant_with_green_standards: str | None = None,
    total_energy_saved_kwh: float | None = None,
    co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e: float | None = None,
    lifecycle_cost_savings_inr: float | None = None,
    insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected: float | None = None,
    insulation_efficiency_status: str,
    payback_period_months: int | None = None,
    measured_at: date,
    notes: str | None = None,
) -> SustainabilityMetric:
    sustainability = SustainabilityMetric(
        reference_id=reference_id,
        reference_kind=reference_kind,
        compliant_with_green_standards=compliant_with_green_standards,
        total_energy_saved_kwh=total_energy_saved_kwh,
        co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e=co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e,
        lifecycle_cost_savings_inr=lifecycle_cost_savings_inr,
        insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected=insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected,
        insulation_efficiency_status=insulation_efficiency_status,
        payback_period_months=payback_period_months,
        measured_at=measured_at,
        notes=notes,
    )
    db.add(sustainability)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(sustainability)
    return sustainability


def update(db: Session, sustainability: SustainabilityMetric) -> SustainabilityMetric:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(sustainability)
    return sustainability


def soft_delete(db: Session, sustainability: SustainabilityMetric) -> SustainabilityMetric:
    sustainability.deleted_at = datetime.utcnow()
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(sustainability)
    return sustainability

import uuid
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.core.id_gen import next_business_id
from src.backend.db.repositories.audit_repo import create_entry
from src.backend.db.repositories.sustainability_repo import (
    create as create_sustainability,
    get_by_id as get_sustainability_by_id,
    list_sustainability,
    soft_delete as soft_delete_sustainability,
    update as update_sustainability,
)
from src.backend.db.repositories.sustainability_repo import (
    get_by_reference_id as get_sustainability_by_reference_id,
)
from src.backend.models.sustainability import SustainabilityMetric
from src.backend.schemas.sustainability import SustainabilityCreate, SustainabilityUpdate


def create_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    data: SustainabilityCreate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = data.model_dump()
    sustainability = create_sustainability(db, payload)

    result = get_sustainability_by_reference_id(db, sustainability.reference_id)
    if result:
        record_event(
            db,
            action="sustainability.create",
            entity_type="sustainability",
            user_id=actor_id,
            entity_id=sustainability.id,
            after_json=_sustainability_to_dict(result),
        )

    return result


def get_sustainability_service(db: Session, sustainability_id: uuid.UUID) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    return get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)


def list_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    reference_kind: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], int, int, int]:
    return list_sustainability(
        db,
        page=page,
        page_size=page_size,
        q=q,
        reference_kind=reference_kind,
    )


def update_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    sustainability_id: uuid.UUID,
    data: SustainabilityUpdate,
    actor_id: uuid.UUID,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    sustainability = get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)
    if not sustainability:
        return None

    before_json = _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability)

    update_data = data.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)
    update_sustainability(db, sustainability_id, update_data)

    sustainability = get_sustainability_by_id(db, sustainability_id)
    after_json = _sustainability_to_dict(sustainability)

    record_event(
        db,
        action="sustainability.update",
        entity_type="sustainability",
        user_id=actor_id,
        entity_id=sustainability_id,
        before_json=before_json,
        after_json=after_json,
    )

    return get_sustainability_by_reference_id(db, sustainability.reference_id)


def soft_delete_sustainability_service(
    db: Session,
    sustainability_id: uuid.UUID,

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime

from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from src.backend.models.sustainability import SustainabilityMetric


def list_sustainability(
    db: Session,
    page: int = 1,
    page_size: int = 20,
    q: str | None = None,
    reference_kind: str | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[SustainabilityMetric], int]:
    query = db.query(SustainabilityMetric)

    if q:
        search = f"%{q}%"
        query = query.filter(
            SustainabilityMetric.reference_id.ilike(search)
            | SustainabilityMetric.compliant_with_green_standards.ilike(search)
            | SustainabilityMetric.notes.ilike(search)
        )

    if reference_kind:
        query = query.filter(SustainabilityMetric.reference_kind == reference_kind)

    total = query.count()
    offset = (page - 1) * page_size
    items = query.order_by(SustainabilityMetric.created_at.desc()).offset(offset).limit(page_size).all()

    return list(items), total


def get_by_id(db: Session, sustainability_id: uuid.UUID) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    return db.query(SustainabilityMetric).filter(SustainabilityMetric.id == sustainability_id).first()


def get_by_reference_id(db: Session, reference_id: str) -> SustainabilityMetric | None:
    return db.query(SustainabilityMetric).filter(SustainabilityMetric.reference_id == reference_id).first()


def create(
    db: Session,
    reference_id: str,
    reference_kind: str,
    compliant_with_green_standards: str | None = None,
    total_energy_saved_kwh: float | None = None,
    co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e: float | None = None,
    lifecycle_cost_savings_inr: float | None = None,
    insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected: float | None = None,
    insulation_efficiency_status: str,
    payback_period_months: int | None = None,
    measured_at: date,
    notes: str | None = None,
) -> SustainabilityMetric:
    sustainability = SustainabilityMetric(
        reference_id=reference_id,
        reference_kind=reference_kind,
        compliant_with_green_standards=compliant_with_green_standards,
        total_energy_saved_kwh=total_energy_saved_kwh,
        co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e=co2_emissions_avoided_tco2e,
        lifecycle_cost_savings_inr=lifecycle_cost_savings_inr,
        insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected=insulation_efficiency_actual_over_expected,
        insulation_efficiency_status=insulation_efficiency_status,
        payback_period_months=payback_period_months,
        measured_at=measured_at,
        notes=notes,
    )
    db.add(sustainability)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(sustainability)
    return sustainability


def update(db: Session, sustainability: SustainabilityMetric) -> SustainabilityMetric:
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(sustainability)
    return sustainability


def soft_delete(db: Session, sustainability: SustainabilityMetric) -> SustainabilityMetric:
    sustainability.deleted_at = datetime.utcnow()

import uuid
from datetime import date, datetime
from enum import StrEnum

from sqlalchemy import Boolean, Date, DateTime, Enum, ForeignKey, Integer, String, Text, func
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import UUID
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column, relationship

from src.backend.db.base import Base


class InnovationType(StrEnum):
    DESIGN_INNOVATION = "Design Innovation"
    PROCESS_INNOVATION = "Process Innovation"
    MATERIAL_INNOVATION = "Material Innovation"
    SERVICE_INNOVATION = "Service Innovation"
    OTHER = "Other"


class Domain(StrEnum):
    ACOUSTIC = "Acoustic"
    THERMAL = "Thermal"
    FIRE = "Fire"
    ENERGY = "Energy"
    SUSTAINABILITY = "Sustainability"
    MATERIAL = "Material"
    OTHER = "Other"


class ProblemStatement(StrEnum):
    INTERNAL_RND = "Internal R&D"

    SITE_CONSTRAINT = "Site Constraint"

    MARKET_NEED = "Market Need"
    OTHER = "Other"

    VALIDATED = "Validated"
    COMMERCIALIZED = "Commercialized"
    KILLED = "Killed"

    INTERNAL_USE_ONLY = "Internal Use Only"
    CLIENT_DEPLOYED = "Client Deployed"
    MONETIZED = "Monetized"
    NOT_YET = "Not Yet"


class ResearchInnovation(Base):

    concept_freeze_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    validation_complete_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    rollout_date: Mapped[date | None] = mapped_column(Date, nullable=True)
    time_to_market_days: Mapped[int | None] = mapped_column(Integer, nullable=True)
    innovation_status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Enum(StartDate), nullable=False, default=StartDate.IDEA.value)

    secondary_owner_id: Mapped[uuid.UUID | None] = mapped_column(UUID(as_uuid=True), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True)
    notes: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
